responseText:
I can do that, but I need a few details and your confirmation before taking any destructive or background actions.

Quick notes up front:
- I can’t keep working in the background unless I create an automation (e.g., a Gmail filter or calendar reminder) you approve. If you want a notification tomorrow I can either schedule a calendar reminder or send you an email notification — you must confirm which.
- Archiving is a destructive/visible action (it will remove messages from your Inbox). I’ll ask explicit confirmation before I archive anything.

Please answer these so I can proceed (pick or fill in each):

1) Which sender? (exact email address or full name as appears in your mail)
2) Scope — what do you want archived?
   - A: All existing threads from that sender (now)
   - B: All future incoming messages from that sender while you’re away (via a filter)
   - C: Both existing threads now and future messages while away
3) “While I am away” — what dates/times? (start and end, or “until I return”)
4) How should I notify you tomorrow that the job is finished?
   - Email to: (address)
   - Calendar reminder at: (time and time zone)
   - Or send a message here
5) Which account should I use? (confirm the email/account if you have multiple)
6) Confirm you want me to proceed with the chosen actions (I will not act until you reply with explicit confirmation).

If you prefer, I can instead give step-by-step instructions for creating the Gmail filter and a calendar reminder so you can set it up yourself. Which would you like?
